gaps.sentence: The village is ___ (ACCESS) only by boat.
gaps.explanation: 'Accessible' = easy to reach; the -ible spelling follows 'access'.

gaps.sentence: The delays have made the project far more ___ (COST) than planned.
gaps.explanation: 'Far more costly' — the comparative adjective is needed after 'more'.

gaps.sentence: The instructions have been ___ (SIMPLE) so that children can follow them.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'have been simplified' — the verb form meaning made simpler.

gaps.sentence: The thief was ___ (ARREST) at the border.

gaps.explanation: 'The wind strengthened' — the verb from STRONG.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (DECIDE) to close the factory was announced yesterday.
The law needs complete ___ (REVISE) before it can work.
